title: Who Will Vote in 2026 Because of You?
description:
You get asked for donations all the time.
Emails, texts, ads—all urgent, all asking for $15, $25, or more. But how often do they tell you exactly where your money goes?

This is different. Every dollar you give at this link buys one thing: stamps.
Every stamp purchased will put a ballot guide in a voter’s hands.

First-class postage is about to go up again. We have a short window to buy stamps now at the lower rate. The more we stock up now, the more voters we can reach in 2026.

This is a chance to make your contribution count in the clearest way possible. Please give if you’re able. You’ll know exactly what you’re funding—and why it matters.

description:
NO KINGS UN-PARADE FAIRPORT, NY
 
GRIT—Greater Rochester Integrity and Truth—is joining the national No Kings Day movement in a nationwide day of protest — and we’re taking it to the burbs. Rather than marching, our Un-Parade protest will take the form of peaceful parade watching along traditional parade routes in suburbs and small towns across Monroe County. Sitting in protest is a poignant symbol, directly taking issue with Trump’s irresponsible use of taxpayer dollars, his defiance of the constitution, and his trampling of our rights. An Un-Parade also allows people of differing physical abilities and all ages to participate.

#Details for Fairport
Time: 10am–12pm
Address: W. Church Street 
We will set up our chairs (or stand) starting at the intersection of West Church St and Main St and extend along W. Church St lining the street all the way to the canal (Perinton Park).

#Suggested Parking: 
Potter Park, at the corner of Potter Place and West Church St or on available side streets along West Church St. Please DO NOT PARK AT FAIRPORT VILLAGE LANDING, which is for the Farm Market and businesses. Carpool if you can.

#Not in Fairport? 
No worries, we are organizing in Pittsford, Brighton*, Webster, Henrietta… if you don’t see your town, and you want to help organize a No Kings Un-Parade, let us know: grit.roc@gmail.com

#Want to Volunteer? 
We need marshals and point people for burbs and villages and towns we haven’t yet signed up. Reach out to us at grit.roc@gmail.com. Be sure to let us know what you’re interested in and what town you’re in.

GRIT is a local group that meets twice a month in person to share knowledge, foster action, and come together as a community to help each other navigate and push back against the current administration. 

By registering for this event, it helps us know how many marshals and helpers we’ll need to have on site to ensure this a safe, peaceful event. And should any details change, it gives us an opportunity to keep you informed. Thank you for understanding. 

*Note — 50501 Rochester chapter is the lead for the Brighton protest; GRIT will be in charge of a specific area reserved for our “Un-Parade”. In other words, GRIT will have its own space for those who don’t want to march but want to protest with lawn chairs and protest signs. In this way, we can be more inclusive to those living in Brighton. Details on exactly where to line up and park in the 12 Corners will be forthcoming. If you want to participate in the Brighton protest, please sign up at https://www.nokings.org/#map. And, if you prefer to march, you can do that too. Win Win. Plus, we’re excited that we can collaborate with this group. Together we’re stronger!

A core principle behind all No Kings events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values.

title: D-Day 81st Anniversary Protest
description:
This Friday June 6th is the 81st anniversary of D-Day. It will be a day of peaceful protest to commemorate the sacrifices of D-Day veterans, and to defend the US Constitution from threats to Democracy — the very democracy our D-Day veterans fought so hard to protect.

The protest is inspired by the “Bonus Army of 1932,” which marched on Washington in the summer of 1932 to successfully persuade politicians to re-instate promised WWI combat bonuses. Just like the Bonus Army of 1932, this Friday’s protests around the country, and on the Burnsville NC Square, will bring the threat of vanishing veterans’ rights to the forefront.

President Donald J. Trump is making quick work of erasing the history and benefits of millions of veterans. Trump’s announcement to rename “Veteran’s Day” to “Victory Day for WWI,” erases the very history of millions of veterans who served after WWI—specifically the millions who served in WWII, Korea, Vietnam, Iraq, Afghanistan, and countless other operations.

Current chaos and cuts to the Veterans Administration have already hobbled the system. Internal VA emails reveal that thousands of the 9 million veterans currently receiving benefits are already enduring gut wrenching cuts. These include loss of cancer treatments, loss of temporary housing for homeless vets, and loss of PACT Act protections to vets exposed to burn pits and other atrocities. Proposed downsizing of VA staff by 70,000 and DOGE-proposed closures of more than17 hospitals will be catastrophic.

Come join us Friday June 6th from 11:30-1:30 at the Burnsville NC Square to support veterans, the US Constitution, and the Declaration of Independence. The event will include readings of both documents, and will include “take-the-oath” ceremonies for any citizen wanting to take the oath to protect and defend the constitution. Anyone who has already taken the oath as part of their job requirement, such as civil servants, politicians, lawyers, judges, or anyone else, may come to re-commit to their oath by re-taking it.

“All US residents, including our bravest —our veterans — are entitled to the inalienable rights of life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness,” said Lea Charlton, a co-founder of Mountain Indivisible of WNC. “We should all be committed every day to protecting those rights.” Mountain Indivisible of WNC is sponsoring the event. It organizes pro-democracy events in Mitchell and Yancey Counties, and supports efforts in Avery County.
